Parker & Sheaffer Writing Instruments
Mid-20th Century

275002137.description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

Belleek
Porcelain Desk Pen Stand with Pen
Circa 1990s, Gilt Accents and Nautical Motif
Crafted by Belleek Pottery in County Fermanagh, Ireland, this glazed porcelain desk stand showcases the maker's renowned craftsmanship in fine ceramic wares. The oval base features low-relief nautical motifs including an embossed scallop shell, starfish, and textured rope border, highlighted by an interior gold-gilt accent line. Complete with an adjustable gold-tone ball-and-socket swivel mount and matching desk pen, it represents both functional executive utility and classic decorative styling.
Glazed ivory porcelain base with detailed embossed seashell, starfish, and rope motifs
Gilded accent line framing the inner tray recess with matching gold-tone swivel pen cup
Fitted green protective felt underside bearing gold foil Belleek crest; blue trademark on rim
Base measures approximately 9" long by 5" wide
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The porcelain base is free of chips, cracks, or crazing, and the gilded trim remains bright. The green felt underside and maker marks are fully intact. The gold-tone desk pen rests securely in the swivel socket with bright finish, showing clear tape wrapped around the center barrel. Ink cartridge functionality is not guaranteed.
